title: Pet Business Marketing Guide: Boost Sales with Online Printing

facts.fact: The page states that pets represent a $69 billion industry, citing the American Pet Products Association.
According to Chron, an online (home-based) pet store can be started for $20 and up.
According to Chron, starting a retail pet product manufacturer costs $15,000 to $500,000.
According to Chron, a pet store franchise costs $25,000 and up to start.
According to Chron, an independently-owned pet retailer costs $100,000 and up to start.
According to Entrepreneur.com, a dog grooming business can be started for under $2,000.
facts.quote: start a dog grooming business for under $2,000

facts.fact: The page states that opening a dog grooming shop in a large city might cost between $50,000 and $150,000.
The page states that a mobile pet groomer can be started for between $10,000 and $50,000, citing NBC News.
facts.quote: A mobile pet groomer could get started for [between $10,000 and $50,000]

facts.fact: Both Chron and Entrepreneur state that a doggy daycare can be started for less than $10,000.
facts.quote: state a doggy daycare can be started for less than $10,000

facts.fact: Paws Dog Daycare puts the cost of starting a doggy daycare between $24,350 and $143,300, with an average of $81,700.
facts.quote: puts the cost between $24,350 and $143,300, with an average of $81,700

facts.fact: The page lists dog walking, pet treats, obedience school, and pooper scooper as pet-related businesses that each cost less than $2,000 to start.
facts.quote: These pet-related businesses all cost less than $2,000 to start

facts.fact: According to the guide, pet stores average $135,000 per year in total sales per employee, a figure the page attributes to an Entrepreneur article.
The guide cites an average annual salary of $40,000 for dog groomers, attributed to Pet Groomer Magazine.
The guide cites a PayScale average annual salary of $28,631 for self-employed doggy daycare operators.
The guide cites a PayScale figure of $37,331 as the average annual salary for doggy daycare at a company.
The guide cites a PayScale average annual salary range of $20,341 to $50,298 for dog walking.
The guide cites a PayScale average annual salary range of $17,200 to $56,419 for pet sitting.
The guide cites an average annual salary range of $27,000 to $60,000 for obedience school trainers, attributed to TopDogTips.
The guide cites an NBC News figure of up to $100,000 in annual salary for a pooper scooper job.
The guide's sample pet-business postcard copy offers six months of free grooming to customers who find a new buddy at PetStore.
facts.quote: Receive six months of FREE grooming when you find your new buddy at PetStore today!

facts.fact: The guide's sample puppy promotion says customers who choose a puppy by June 1 receive grooming services valued at $500.
facts.quote: you'll also receive six months of FREE grooming services valued at $500!

facts.fact: The guide's sample puppy promotion sets a June 1 deadline for choosing a puppy to receive the free grooming offer.
facts.quote: And if you choose your new puppy by June 1,

facts.fact: The guide describes a four-step process for writing marketing copy: headline, benefits, offer, and call to action.
facts.quote: Follow this four-step process to incredible copy that boosts your return on investment:

facts.fact: The guide recommends testing, tracking, and tweaking marketing campaigns, which it calls the three T's.
facts.quote: Test, track and tweak - these three T’s will help you craft even stronger marketing campaigns over time.

facts.fact: The Pet Care Service Association describes itself on this page as a network where members train alongside 3,000 other pet industry businesses.
facts.quote: Network and train along with 3,000 other pet industry businesses.
